findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Requests: unsafe use of eval/exec
 * @description Detects any use of eval or exec within the requests library, which could enable code injection if fed untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/requests-unsafe-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python

from Call call, Name func
where
  func = call.getFunc() and
  func.getId() in ["eval", "exec"]
select call, "Use of " + func.getId() + " may allow code execution if given untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: The package might use eval/exec, which is dangerous if reachable from untrusted input.

message.text: Use of exec may allow code execution if given untrusted input.
